# Luu Auto Repair

> Auto repair shop based in Austin, Texas. Don tells you what your car needs, and what it doesn't. Straight answers, fair prices and the job done right, at the cream metal shop with the red sign at 8225 N Lamar.

- Phone: (512) 837-1417
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Service area: Austin, Pflugerville, Wells Branch, Round Rock, Jollyville
- Google rating: 4.9 from 185 reviews
- Request a quote: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/auto-repair/texas/luu-auto-repair/quote.html
- Book a visit: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/auto-repair/texas/luu-auto-repair/book.html

## Services
- Honest diagnostics & second opinions: Tell Don what the car is doing. He finds the problem, shows it to you and tells you straight what needs fixing and what can wait. Got an estimate from another shop? Bring it in.
- A/C recharge & leak checks: A/C blowing warm? Don recharges the system and adds leak-detection dye, so a slow leak can be found if the cooling fades again.
- Brakes & suspension: Brake pads and rotors, plus the shakes and clunks: control arms and suspension parts checked and replaced when they actually need it.
- Oil leaks & fluid service: Oil leaks tracked down and fixed, including rear engine oil seals, plus transmission fluid service. Customers say Don explains each item on the invoice.
- Electrical: The shop has long been listed as Luu Auto & Electric. Electrical problems and warning lights diagnosed and repaired.
- Maintenance & check-ups: Oil changes, tire checks and routine maintenance for daily drivers and older cars alike, and he'll tell you when something isn't due yet.

## About
Luu Auto Repair is the cream-colored metal shop with the red sign and the two iron Texas stars at 8225 N Lamar Blvd in North Austin. Don runs it, and he's the one customers talk about: he raises the hood, points to the problem and tells you straight what needs fixing and what can wait. There are no frills here, just fair prices and honest work. A lot of customers come in because a friend sent them, some after another shop's estimate, and some have been bringing their cars here for years. Customers say the owner answers the phone himself. Cars that stay overnight are kept behind a locked gate, and there's a drop box at the gate.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Where is Luu Auto Repair?
  A: 8225 N Lamar Blvd, Austin, TX 78753. Look for the cream metal building with the red LUU AUTO REPAIR sign and the two iron Texas stars.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
- Q: Do I need an appointment?
  A: Call (512) 837-1417 first. Customers suggest calling about a week ahead because the shop gets busy, and bigger repairs can mean leaving the car for a few days.
- Q: Is my car safe if it stays overnight?
  A: Yes. Cars that stay at the shop are kept behind a locked gate.
- Q: Will you tell me if a repair can wait?
  A: Yes. Customers say Don has told them their tires didn't need replacing yet and their oil change wasn't due. He only recommends what the car actually needs.
- Q: Can you give me a second opinion on another shop's estimate?
  A: Yes. Customers have brought in estimates from other shops and dealerships, and Don has told them which parts of the job the car actually needed and which it didn't.
- Q: Is it cheaper than the dealership?
  A: Customers say the cost is significantly lower than the dealership. Call and describe the problem to talk it through with Don.
- Q: Do you work on older cars?
  A: Yes. Customers bring in everything from daily drivers to a classic Toyota Land Cruiser. Call and tell Don what you drive.
